title: Plan a mobile app release
summary: Mobile releases go through app store review and users update slowly. Plan for both.

beginner: Check the app store rules that apply to your features.
Allow time for review, and for rejection and resubmission.
Prepare the store listing: description, screenshots and privacy details.
Release to a small share of users first.
Plan for users on older versions.
intermediate: Check store guidelines and plan review time.
experienced: Use feature flags to decouple release from deployment.
Track crash rates and ratings after release.

canDelegateTo.task: Prepare builds and handle store submission

toolExamples.github: Automate builds and track release tags.

leaderView.good: Mobile releases allow for app store review and slow user updates.
ask: How long does app review take us, and is it in the plan?
How do we handle users on old versions?
signs: Old app versions break when the backend changes.
